notes.note: Traced the private activation from durable Session-owner and binding preflight through park, restricted resume, canonical send and observed process release. Checked that provider qualification and process-local exclusivity add no public capability and that durable group reservation and ACK settlement still need a host caller.

Traced normal command, Session start and resume, provider turn, owned stop and idle parking through the added private activation checks. The check admits the ordinary path when there is no retained owner. For the retained path only, coverage adds exact user and binding, confirmed retirement, and a fence on uncertain effects. There is no caller from the API or hosted surfaces. Inspected the synthetic Inspect request still and recording description against the existing exact-request path. Their evidence remains scoped to that capture.
